error_too_large: The file is larger than {detail} MiB.
error_not_markdown: MemoryStick opens Markdown and text files only (.md, .markdown, .mdown, .mkd, .mkdn, .txt).
error_not_utf8: The file is not UTF-8 text.
error_cannot_save: The preferences could not be saved: {detail}
preferences_language_desc: The language of MemoryStick's own text. Documents stay as they are written.
preferences_appearance_desc: Adjust the theme, accents and visual effects.
preferences_theme_desc: Until you pick one, MemoryStick follows the system's light or dark mode in Gruvbox.
preferences_colors_desc: An accent colour of your own for links, selection and focus, in every theme.
preferences_auto_accent_desc: Uses each theme's own accent instead.
preferences_effects_desc: Manage animations. Reduce motion, in Accessibility, turns them all off.
preferences_animations_desc: The contents panel slides in, and links to a heading scroll to it smoothly.
preferences_preview_body: Body text, as a document shows it, with a link and some inline code.
preferences_high_contrast_desc: Text and borders stand out more from the background, in every theme.
preferences_dyslexia_font_desc: Shows all text in OpenDyslexic, except code, which stays monospaced.
preferences_reduce_motion_desc: Turns off every animation. Follows the system's setting until you change it.
preferences_text_size_desc: Scales all text, on top of the text size in Appearance.
preferences_about_desc: A Markdown viewer from Project Colony.
